description: agent-fabric's rules for fabric-pr arm: which changes are its security boundary, so that a pull request touching one with fewer work commits than the minimum (commits.boundary_min in policies/arming.json and the settings repository's repos/agent-fabric.json; `fabric-pr arm --dry-run` prints it) is armed only on the owner's word, and one at or above it is named as a boundary change in its basis. boundary.paths: the fence and every guard (policies/, tools/fabric/guards/, runtime/claude-code/hooks/ and the settings that register them), what may change what (policies/authority.json, identities/keys/), the secret stores and every tool that reads, writes or runs with a secret (tools/fabric/secretstore/, secret_store.py, secrets_sync.py, secret_run.py, store_*.py, accounts), the control plane's signing and actions (tools/fabric/control/, and runtime/control/ for the agentd unit and config), provisioning, which runs as root on every host (runtime/provisioning/, new_agent*.py, python_pin.py), the launcher, which composes every session's environment (tools/fabric/launch.py, runtime/openrouter/), the GitHub layer's repository resolution (tools/fabric/gh.py), the routing that picks and gates the review model (routing/policies/, routing.py, the launcher's routing), the reviewer's agent file and the installers that write the hooks and the fence (runtime/claude-code/agents/, bootstrap, install_agent_files.py), the agent's identity (runtime/identity.py), this gate itself (arm.json, and arm.py with the arm_rules.py and arm_policy.py split out of it: in agent-fabric a pull request is judged by the rules on its own branch, so the rules must be boundary), CI (.github/), and words where the boundary is a file anywhere (secret, token, credential, keyring, signing, trust, auth, guard). boundary.exempt is dropped first: Markdown prose under docs/ and memory/, a project's distilled memory under .agent-fabric/memory/, and a locale's translations. No classes. waiver_role is null: in agent-fabric only the owner waives the boundary, by arming it themselves.

changes.python-control-plane-path: The control plane's code now lives under tools/fabric/control/ (Wave 8 s8, PR #170, REQUEST 01a12507-fbd7-77bd-b436-1f719845e9c1, the owner's word through fabric-coordinator): ^tools/fabric/control/ joins the boundary; ^runtime/control/ stays, for the agentd unit and its config.
changes.arm-gate-modules: runtime/github/arm.sh went with the shell shims (PR #162), and arm.py's gates were split into arm_rules.py (the owner's-word phrase, the arm.json loader) and arm_policy.py, which the pattern missed: ^runtime/github/arm\.sh$ leaves, ^tools/fabric/github/(arm(_rules|_policy)?|pr_gate|repo_policy)\.py$ names what is there (fabric-coordinator's REQUEST 01a14df6-c6b0-7c12-b03f-8299e9304b91, a widening of the boundary, which needs no owner's word, through devex-tooling). pr_gate.py, which decides whether the head's review gate is met, and repo_policy.py, which reads the arming policy, are what arm.py imports to decide; a change to either could arm an unreviewed PR, so they join it too (fabric-coordinator, answering devex-tooling's NOT-VERIFIED in its REPLY 01a14e59).

retired.runtime/control/sign.mjs: Deleted with the Node control plane (PR #170, REQUEST 01a12507-fbd7-77bd-b436-1f719845e9c1, fabric-coordinator with the owner's word); the case moved to tools/fabric/control/sign.py, which carries the same signing.
retired.runtime/github/arm.sh: Deleted with the shell shims (PR #162); the arm is tools/fabric/github/arm.py, a case, with arm_rules.py and arm_policy.py now cases too (fabric-coordinator's REQUEST 01a14df6-c6b0-7c12-b03f-8299e9304b91, a widening of the boundary, which needs no owner's word).
